{{Quote|No one's seen it, but it's there. You can feel its heartbeat in the walls.|[[Torian Cadera]]|<ref name="Heart of Darkness" />}}
'''Akure''', also known as the '''Ghost in the Darkness'''<ref name="Akure" /> or the '''Beast of Darkness''',<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> was a [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] created by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the centuries before the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Akure" /> A hulking [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]-like creature with four tusks and grey-black skin riddled with cracks through which a substance like magma was visible,<ref name="Heart of Darkness" /> Akure was released by the Emperor into the caverns beneath the surface of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], and survived for decades by feeding off both the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and those foolish enough to enter its domain.<ref name="Akure" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Akure was easily three times the height of a normal [[Human/Legends|Human]] and could jump great distances easily. However, the most recent [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] was sent to kill Akure as part of an initiation into the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture, and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Battle in the Lair of the Ghost|fought]] and killed the Sithspawn in the [[Lair of the Ghost]] beneath the surface of Dromund Kaas.<ref name="Heart of Darkness" />
